components.title: Filter returned orders
components.what: Select all order rows with status returned.

components.title: Deduplicate
components.what: Remove exact duplicate rows (same order_id and all fields) so each order counts once.

components.title: Sum units
components.what: Sum the units field across the deduplicated returned orders to get total units.

The sum of these 17 unit values is indeed 293. However, the premise of the prompt defines revenue rules ('returned orders contribute nothing') which might tempt an interpretation that returned units count as 0 if asking about effective volume, though the literal question explicitly asks for units of returned orders.
